rounds.plan: Rotate in place to survey all six directions before committing to a route.
Advance into the corridor ahead to begin exploration.
Turn in place to survey all six directions after the move.
Proceed forward along the open corridor to explore toward the goal.
Turn right 60 degrees to bypass the mirror wall, then advance along the open side.
Backtrack to the previous junction to explore other open directions.
At the starting cell facing a mirror ahead, turn right to explore the adjacent open edge.
Return to the known open cell to the north, then re-evaluate branches from there.
Probe the open direction to the left of the blocked forward wall.
Turn left away from the mirror ahead and advance into the side passage.
Turn left away from the mirror wall and advance along the open side corridor.
Face the next untested direction (60° right of blocked heading) and advance if open.
Try the next untried direction: turn two steps to the left and advance.
Rotate a full turn in place to survey all six directions for the green beacon or an open route.
Advance forward along the clear central path toward the beacon.
Backtrack out of the dead end by turning 180 degrees and returning the way we came.
Turn left away from the mirror ahead and advance into the side passage.
The forward edge is a mirror wall. Turn 120° left to align with an open diagonal corridor, then advance two cells.
Turn right at the dead end and advance along the open side corridor.
Return via known open path to the junction, then probe the untested straight continuation from the previous junction.
Mirror wall directly ahead; turn left 60 degrees and advance along the open side passage.
Forward blocked by mirror; turn right 60° and advance along the open side passage.
Forward is blocked; turn right 60° to probe the untested side edge and advance if open.
Advance along the clear corridor toward the distant mirror wall, stopping short of a likely dead end.
Turn left away from the mirror wall and advance toward the cyan ring in the left corridor.
Forward blocked by mirror. Turn right 60° toward the floor beacons and advance.
Face the mirror wall; rotate right 60° to inspect the side corridor without entering it yet.
Backtrack to the junction at (2,2), then probe the unexplored southwest direction from there.
Turn left toward the side corridor and advance to explore the unvisited cell.
Probe the right-side edge from this dead-end; if open, advance.
Turn right to face the known open edge, then move back to the previous cell to explore untested branches.
Probe the only untested direction from this junction: turn left twice and advance if open.
Survey all six directions from this cell to look for the actual green beacon and open routes.
Move forward along the visibly open tiled corridor toward the marked floor tile.
At the current dead-end cell, test the only untested side exit: turn to face 120° right and advance if open.
Turn 60° right away from the blocked mirror edge and advance if the side passage is open.
Return to the adjacent junction, then test the unexplored north branch from there.
Probe an untested side exit from the eastern edge: turn to face direction 60 and advance if open.
Backtrack along the edge we entered from: turn 120° right to face the open return direction and advance.
Continue along the clear straight corridor for two cells to approach the distant mirror wall.
Return east to the far junction at (4,2) and test the untried southeast exit.
Probe the right-forward exit from the current beacon-ring cell.
Rotate a full turn in place to survey all six directions from this frontier cell for the green beacon and open exits.
Probe the only untested inward exit from the current cell: turn right to face southwest and advance.
Turn right to face the side corridor away from the mirror wall ahead.
Return to the junction at (4,1), then advance straight to probe the unexplored eastern edge.
Head to the western junction and test its unexplored inward exit.
Move to the neighboring junction and test its unexplored southwest exit.
Backtrack one cell out of the dead end, then rotate fully in place to survey all six exits from the previous cell.
Probe the open-looking left-front cell toward the visible beacon ring: turn left 60°, then advance.
Mirror directly ahead reflects the robot; turn right toward the open side corridor and advance.
Wall directly ahead; turn right 60° and advance along the open side corridor.
Mirror directly ahead. Turn left toward the open corridor and advance two cells to explore.
From the current cell, only the back-right exit remains untested. Turn left twice to face it and advance.
Turn left to face the known open cell behind us, then step back out of the dead end.
Survey all six directions from this dead-end cell before backtracking or turning.
Probe the last untested exit from the current cell: turn left twice to face the unexplored diagonal and advance.
Navigate to the unexplored cell at (5,-2) via the known open corner, then re-evaluate.
Turn left away from the facing mirror and advance into the open side passage.
Facing a mirror wall; turn right 60° toward the open side and advance.
Turn right away from the mirror wall and advance along the open side corridor.
Forward blocked by mirror. Turn left toward the open floor path and advance.
Probe the remaining untested left-side exit; if it opens, move forward.
Forward and both side exits are blocked; turn 120° left to face the open cell we entered from, then step back out.
Advance along the clear straight corridor toward the distant central opening.
Rotate in place to survey all six exits from this new dead-end cell before choosing an unexplored corridor.
Turn left into the open corridor and advance several cells to explore.
Mirror directly ahead. Turn right 60° toward the open corridor and advance.
Turn left away from the mirror wall and advance along the open side corridor.
Backtrack along the known corridor to the (1,1) frontier, then probe its untested right-hand exit.
Survey all six directions from this cell to find an open exit or the green beacon.
Back out of the dead end along the known open direction, then survey all six directions from the previous cell.
Return to the nearby C-cell and test its unexplored north exit for new territory.
Turn left 60° toward the open orange-ring side cell and step into it.
Mirror directly ahead. Follow the wall to the right: turn right 60 degrees and advance if open.
Turn right 60° to inspect the adjacent edge before moving.
Rotate a full turn in place to survey all six directions from this cell for open exits and the green beacon.
From the start cell, test the unexplored western exit: turn to face west and advance.
Facing a mirror wall; rotate right 60° to an untested side direction and advance if open.
Probe the untested right-hand exit from this cell: turn right two steps and advance if open.
Forward blocked by a mirror post. Turn left toward the open gap beside the orange ring and advance.
Rotate a full turn in place to survey all six directions from this dead-end cell and identify the open exit.
Face the only untested direction (opposite current mirror wall) by turning 180° right, then inspect before moving.
Exit the dead-end cell by advancing straight back along the open corridor.
Mirror wall directly ahead; turn right 60° toward the open side corridor and advance.
From this cell, test the only untested direction—opposite the blocked headings—by turning left twice and moving back along the entry corridor.
Advance along the visibly open central corridor to continue exploration.
Return to the central junction at (3,0) via the known loop, then probe its unexplored southeast exit.
Forward is blocked by the central mirror post. Turn left toward the open ring corridor and advance to continue searching for the actual green beacon.
The mirror is directly ahead. Turn right 60° toward the open ring corridor and advance to keep exploring for the true beacon.
Mirror directly ahead; turn left toward the open side corridor and advance.
Forward is blocked. Turn left 60° to an untested side exit and advance if open.
Mirror directly ahead; turn left toward the open side corridor and advance.
Front is a mirror wall; turn left 60° and advance into the open side corridor.
Turn left away from the two-cell mirror wall and advance along the likely open corner passage.
Turn left once to face the cell we just came from, then step back out to avoid the mirror dead end.
Rotate 180° in place to check behind for the actual green beacon before committing to a side corridor.
Return to the previous cell, then survey all six directions to identify unexplored exits.
At the dead-end mirror, turn left and advance into the open side corridor.
Reverse out of the dead end: turn 120° left to face the open cell we came from, then step back.
Probe the untested forward edge from the cyan-ring cell to check for new territory.
Apply a right-hand wall-following step: turn right away from the mirror and advance if the side corridor is open.
Turn right away from the mirror wall and advance along the open side passage.
Advance straight along the clear central corridor for several cells toward the distant reflection.
Forward blocked by a mirror wall; turn left 60° toward the open cyan-ring side passage and advance.
Apply right-hand wall following: turn right away from the mirror and advance into the adjacent open corridor.
Left and forward are mirror-blocked. Turn 180° and backtrack to the previous open cell.
Advance straight down the clear central corridor to cover distance toward the goal.
Front is blocked by a mirror wall. Turn right 60° to inspect the side corridor before moving.
Turn right toward the open side corridor and advance one cell.
Reverse out of the mirror dead end: turn 180° and move back to the previous open cell.
Rotate in place to survey all six directions from this cyan-ring cell before choosing the corridor toward the actual green beacon.
Backtrack one cell to the junction and then inspect the untested side exit.
Front is a mirror reflection; follow the wall to the right by turning 60° and advancing into the open side corridor.
Follow the clear central corridor forward several cells to cover distance before reassessing at the next junction.
Follow the right-hand wall: turn right 60° away from the mirror ahead and advance if the side corridor is open.
Backtrack to the previous open cell, then rotate in place to survey all six exits for an untested route.
Continue straight along the open central corridor to cover ground toward the actual beacon.
Turn right away from the mirror wall and advance into the open side corridor.
Front is a mirror wall. Turn left toward the nearest open side corridor and advance one cell.
Mirror directly ahead. Turn right toward the cyan floor-ring corridor and advance into it.
Three of six directions are wall-blocked here; reverse 180° and back out into the open junction, then advance two cells.
Back out of the dead end along the known open direction: turn left 60° and step forward.
Turn right toward the visible cyan floor-ring beacon and step into that side aisle.
Face the mirror; turn left away from it and advance into the open side aisle.
Survey all six directions from this junction to identify the actual green beacon and open routes before moving.
Advance along the open central corridor in the current facing direction to cover ground before reassessing.
Front is a large mirror wall. Turn right 60° toward the open side aisle and advance.
Test the untested 60° left direction from this junction: turn left, advance if open.
Back out of the mirror dead end to the previous junction, then reassess there.
Advance straight down the long open central aisle to cover distance toward the beacon.
Front is a mirror wall. Turn left toward the closer cyan floor-ring cell and step onto it.
Facing a mirror ahead; apply a right-hand wall-following step by turning right and advancing into the side corridor.
Turn left back to the open corridor heading and advance one cell.
Forward and right are blocked here; test the untried left side by turning left 60° and advancing if open.
Forward is a mirror wall. Turn left toward the purple-ring aisle and advance one cell to skirt the central mirror structure.
Turn right 60° to test the untried forward direction from this cell, then advance if open.
Test the untried right-side exit from this blocked junction: turn right 60° and advance if open.
Backtrack to the adjacent junction, then test the remaining open edge toward the unexplored boundary cell.
Face the mirror ahead; turn left into the open side aisle and advance several cells while it stays clear.
Turn right away from the mirror wall and advance along the open side aisle.
Reverse out of the mirror dead end to the last known open cell: turn 180° and step back.
Survey all six directions from the current cell to locate the actual green beacon before advancing.
Forward is a close mirror post. Turn left 60° into the open side aisle and commit forward several cells along that corridor.
Turn left 60° to an untested heading and advance if the aisle is open.
Turn right toward the visible cyan beacon ring and step forward into its aisle.
Turn right to the untested diagonal exit and advance if it is open.
Current cell is a mirror dead end. Turn 180° and step back along the known open edge to the previous junction.
Advance straight along the clear central lane to cover ground toward the unexplored region.
Mirror directly ahead; turn right toward the open aisle where floor is visible and advance.
Move to the adjacent junction and probe the untested eastward edge across the mirror barrier.
Turn back to the open central lane and advance two cells along it.
Back out of the mirror dead end by turning 180° and retreating two cells along the open corridor.
Advance one cell along the open central corridor and reassess before the mirror reflection.
Survey all six directions from this cell to locate the actual green beacon before moving.
Take the unexplored opening 60° left (the clear corridor with the cyan floor ring) and advance one cell.
At a cyan-ring cell facing a mirror; turn right into the open side corridor and advance two cells along it.
Mirror wall ahead; rotate left to the next untested heading and advance if clear.
Test the untried left-side heading from the mirror dead end; advance one cell if open.
Mirror directly ahead. Turn right into the open side aisle alongside the blue floor ring and advance.
Turn left toward the open side aisle past the cyan floor ring and commit forward along it.
Facing a mirror dead end with the robot’s own reflection ahead; reverse 180° and return along the corridor we entered.
Mirror wall directly ahead; turn right and advance along the open side aisle.
Dead end ahead; follow the right-hand wall by turning right and advancing one cell.
Continue along the currently open central corridor for two cells, then reassess at the next junction.
Mirror ahead blocks progress; turn left toward the side corridor and advance one cell.
Mirror ahead; apply right-hand wall following by turning right 60° and advancing if the side edge is open.
Test the next untried side exit from this mirror dead end: turn right 60° and advance if open.
Back out two cells along the known open route to the previous junction, then turn a full circle to survey all six exits before choosing the next branch.
Advance along the long clear central corridor toward the distant junction.
Front is blocked directly in the mirror post; turn right toward the right-hand cyan-ring lane and advance one cell.
Back out of the mirror dead end along the known open corridor, three cells, to return to the previous junction.
Mirror directly ahead reflecting the robot. Turn left 60° into the open side corridor and advance down the lane marked with cyan floor rings.
Mirror dead end ahead; follow the right-hand wall by turning right 60° and advancing if the side edge is open.
Survey all six directions from this dead-end cell to locate the actual green beacon or an open return route.
Turn to face the long open corridor seen opposite (3 lefts), then advance several cells down that clear lane.
Forward is a mirror wall. Apply consistent right-hand wall following: turn right 60° and advance into the adjacent open side corridor.
Turn right away from the mirror and advance into the side aisle.
Reverse out of the three-way mirror dead end: turn right to face the open return corridor, then retrace three cells along it.
At the mirror wall, follow the right-hand side corridor and advance along it.
Mirror dead end; turn 120° right to face the open return corridor and backtrack three cells.
Rotate a full 360° in place to survey all six directions from this dead-end cell before choosing an exit.
Take the right-hand branch into the adjacent cyan-ring cell.
Exit the mirror dead end via the open right-hand side corridor and advance two cells to look for the actual green beacon.
Turn left away from the blocking mirror and advance into the open side corridor.
Reverse out of the mirror dead end: turn 180° to face the open cell we came from, then step back.
Probe the right-hand side corridor from this mirror dead end, advancing two cells if open.
At the mirror dead end, turn left to the untested side aisle and advance one cell.
Survey all six directions from the current cell to locate the actual green beacon before moving.
Mirror directly ahead; turn right into the adjacent open side aisle and advance one cell.
Back out of the mirror dead end along the known open path to the previous junction.
Rotate a full turn in place to survey all six directions from this mirror dead-end cell and locate the actual green beacon or an open route.
Advance straight down the open lane ahead for a few cells to seek the actual green beacon cell.
Survey all six headings from this cell to spot the actual green beacon before committing to a path.
Turn right to the clearly open long aisle and advance two cells along it.
Survey all six directions in place to locate the actual green beacon before moving.
Advance several cells along the long open central corridor to search for the actual green beacon.
Take the open left-hand aisle: turn left 60° and advance several cells down the cyan-ring lane toward the beacon.
Forward is blocked by a mirror. Turn right to test the approach direction, then advance if open.
Enter the open right-hand aisle, then perform a forward-biased zigzag sweep to search for the green beacon.
